raw.details:
F-Cube Bug Bounty | Discover. Report. Improve.

Join the F-Cube Bug Bounty, hosted by Oronzo LLP, and help us make F-Cube safer, more reliable, and easier to use.

https://chat.whatsapp.com/DA85Ghe57vnGZ8SAV5gv6r

Explore the app, identify bugs and vulnerabilities within the authorized scope, and submit clear reports to help improve app security, functionality, performance, and user experience.

  • Organized by: Oronzo LLP
  • Event Dates: November 6–8, 2026.
  • Mode: Completely Online️
  • Entry: Free
  • Reward: Top contributors will have an opportunity to be considered for paid internships at Oronzo LLP.

Event Schedule:

Friday, November 6 | 6:00 PM IST

Kickoff Meeting & Walkthrough

Join the online kickoff session to understand the event objectives, authorized testing scope, participation guidelines, and bug submission process.

Saturday, November 7 | Bug Hunting Begins

Test permitted F-Cube features, identify bugs, document findings, and submit reports with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence.

Sunday, November 8 | Final Testing & Submission

Complete your testing and submit all bug reports before the final deadline.

Submission Deadline: Sunday, November 8, at 9:00 PM IST.

Areas to Explore:

  • App Security: Identify potential security vulnerabilities within the authorized scope.
  • Feature & Functional Bugs: Report broken features, errors, and unexpected behavior.
  • Performance & Reliability: Identify slow responses, crashes, and reliability issues.
  • UI/UX Issues: Highlight usability, navigation, and interface problems.

Rewards & Recognition:

Top contributors will have an opportunity to be considered for paid internships at Oronzo LLP. Submissions will be reviewed based on validity, impact, reproducibility, and duplicate checks. Internship opportunities are subject to the organizers' evaluation and selection process.

Participation Guidelines:

  • Test only F-Cube assets and features explicitly authorized by the organizers.

  • Submit genuine findings with clear reproduction steps and relevant evidence.

  • Never access other users' private data or accounts.

  • Do not perform denial-of-service attacks, destructive testing, spam, or social engineering.

  • Keep findings private and follow the organizers' responsible disclosure guidelines.

  • All submissions are subject to review, validation, and duplicate checks.

Join the Hunt:

  • Help us identify issues, strengthen app security, and deliver a better experience for every F-Cube user.
  • Find responsibly. Report clearly. Help us build a safer F-Cube.

Register now and be part of the F-Cube Bug Bounty!

Important: The kickoff meeting link, authorized testing scope, and bug submission form will be shared through the official event communication channels.
